$comment: The portal app this suite renders against. `pnpm setup:portal` clones it into
.portal/ (gitignored) so the test repo bootstraps itself — no machine-specific
paths, same behaviour locally and in CI.
`ref` is pinned to a commit so a fresh clone reproduces the committed baselines.
Bump it deliberately: re-run setup, re-run the suite, and if pixels moved, that
IS the regression report. Set PORTAL_REF to test another ref without editing this.
